result.note: Tested the shift from AQI-triggered to fixed-calendar winter curbs in Delhi and the key measures announced in July 2026.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Delhi government announced measures to tackle winter air pollution. Consider the following statements about these measures:
items: Restrictions between November 1 and February 28 will apply only on days when the AQI crosses a specified threshold.
Public and private offices must move 50% of their staff to remote work between November 1 and January 31.
Parking fees will be doubled to discourage the use of private vehicles.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the curbs will run continuously from November 1 to February 28 regardless of the AQI, replacing the earlier practice of acting only after air quality deteriorated. The package also includes staggered government office hours, a ban on non-essential outdoor civil construction and cash incentives for scrapping old vehicles for EVs.
questions.source: Now, curbs will run continuously from November 1 to February 28, regardless of the AQI.
